C-SELECTIVE-RERUNS.IntentSummary: Implement the two approved release steps in sequence: reliable reruns with truthful scores, then selection of existing review topics.

T-001.Title: Keep completed attempts and report coverage

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Only successful finish publishes an attempt; carried results identify their origin. Interrupted repeats leave the completed report available. Unknown and inapplicable sections have no numeric value.

T-002.Title: Expose the five topics through section routing and findings

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Secrets plus tests after full produces a complete report. Repeated topic selections route once to their owner, with requested topics and actual scope shown; reports retain one deduction per root cause.
